generated_plan.learning_plan_title: 3-Month AI Engineer (Data Analyst/Analytics/AI Engineer) Learning Plan
prerequisites: Familiarity with Python, Java, C++, C
Built small academic and personal projects
learning_strategy: Balance theoretical knowledge with hands-on coding and project building.
Utilize online courses, documentation, and practical platforms (Kaggle, GitHub).
Prioritize end-to-end projects for portfolio development.
Focus on MLOps and Cloud fundamentals for global market relevance.

topics: Advanced Python for Data Science (List comprehensions, generators, lambda)
NumPy (Arrays, operations, broadcasting)
Pandas (DataFrames, Series, loading, basic manipulation)
Practice: Kaggle 'Getting Started' data manipulation challenges
Advanced Pandas (Grouping, merging, pivoting, time series, missing values)
Data Visualization (Matplotlib, Seaborn for EDA)
SQL (SELECT, FROM, WHERE, GROUP BY, ORDER BY, JOINs)
Python-SQL interaction (e.g., sqlite3)
Practice: Comprehensive EDA on a dataset, SQL query exercises
Statistics (Descriptive, Inferential, Hypothesis Testing)
Probability (Conditional, Bayes' Theorem, Distributions)
Linear Algebra Refresher (Intuition for ML)
Scikit-learn Introduction (Preprocessing, Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Trees)
Practice: Implement basic statistical analysis, build simple ML models
Supervised Learning (K-NN, SVM, Random Forests, Gradient Boosting basics)
Model Evaluation (Metrics, Cross-validation)
Feature Engineering (Creation, Selection)
Unsupervised Learning Intro (K-Means, PCA)
Practice: Moderately complex Kaggle dataset with various models & tuning

monthly_breakdown.title: Machine Learning & Deep Learning
focus_areas: Natural Language Processing with RNNs & Transformers

topics: Gradient Boosting Machines (XGBoost, LightGBM)
Hyperparameter Optimization (Grid Search, Random Search, Bayesian Optimization intro)
Handling Imbalanced Datasets
Model Interpretability (SHAP, LIME intro)
Practice: Tabular data competition, focus on tuning and interpretation
Neural Network Basics (Perceptrons, Activation, Backprop, Loss, Optimizers)
PyTorch/TensorFlow Refresher (Data loading, custom layers, training loops)
Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) for classification/regression
Regularization (Dropout, L1/L2)
Practice: Implement an MLP from scratch using preferred framework (e.g., MNIST)
Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) Architecture
Image Preprocessing & Data Augmentation
Transfer Learning with Pre-trained CNNs (ResNet, VGG)
Computer Vision Applications (Image classification, Object detection concepts)
Practice: Build an image classifier with transfer learning on a custom dataset
Text Preprocessing (Tokenization, Stemming, Lemmatization, Embeddings)
Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs, LSTMs, GRUs)
Attention Mechanism & Transformers (High-level understanding)
NLP Applications (Sentiment analysis, Text generation basics)
Practice: Build a sentiment analysis model using LSTMs or pre-trained transformers
Version Control (Git/GitHub advanced workflows)
Containerization with Docker (Creating Dockerfiles for ML apps)
Web Framework for ML APIs (FastAPI or Flask)
Deployment Concepts (REST APIs, Microservices, CI/CD overview)
Practice: Create a Dockerized REST API for an ML model using FastAPI
Cloud Platform Overview (Focus on AWS/GCP/Azure - e.g., Sagemaker/Vertex AI)
Cloud Storage (S3, GCS, Azure Blob Storage)
Model Deployment on Cloud (Basic Endpoints)
ML Model Monitoring Concepts (Drift)
Interactive Web Apps (Streamlit/Dash for dashboards)
Practice: Deploy Dockerized API to a cloud platform, build a Streamlit dashboard
Capstone Project (Initiate a significant end-to-end project)
Choose 1-2 Advanced Topics based on interest:
- Time Series Analysis (ARIMA, Prophet, Deep Learning)
- Recommendation Systems (Collaborative Filtering, Content-Based)
- Reinforcement Learning Basics (Q-learning)
- Big Data Tools (Spark concepts)
Practice: Dedicated time on capstone project, integrate advanced topics if applicable
Capstone Project Completion & Documentation (GitHub README)
Portfolio Building (Curate projects, Kaggle, personal)
Resume & LinkedIn Optimization (Highlight projects, skills)
Interview Preparation (DS/ML questions, coding challenges - LeetCode Medium)
Networking (LinkedIn)
Practice: Finalize capstone, extensive job prep and practice
